_comment: Copy to config/voxel_config.json and edit. Relative paths are relative to project_root; a value starting with @pkg/ is relative to this package (code and templates that ship with it). Each key is a logical path prefix used in the code; its value is where that data lives on your machine. The layout below is the one scripts/run_upstream.py writes.
reference_receptor: <receptor id every chain is fitted onto, e.g. the medoid of your repertoire>

upstream._comment: scripts/run_upstream.py and pipeline/code/paths.py: the data-set config (relative to this package), the input root (read-only inputs / earlier outputs) and the write root (this run's outputs, read first); empty root = project_root. prefix_aliases {package path prefix: path under the input root} redirect input-root reads, longest prefix first (e.g. to read an existing project with a different layout).

report.dataset_label: your data set (e.g. GEO accession, tissue, cell type)
condition_labels: label when the cells flag is true
report.flag_condition: <raw condition value shown as the flagged group (e.g. GF)>

expected._comment: Dataset-specific expected values the checks compare against (tolerances stay in the code). A key left unset, or still holding its placeholder, fails every check that uses it. n_structures: folded models (rows of the landmark file, PDBs); n_molecules: distinct V-domain protein sequences (one representative each); reference_receptor_index: row of reference_receptor in the landmark file; n_anchors (_alpha, _beta): framework anchors in the landmark file; n_control_pairs: near-identical control pairs; n_background_pairs / n_within_class_pairs: pairs left of the 60,000 random / 40,000 within-length-class draws (default_rng(0)) after dropping self-pairs; n_benchmark_pairs: accepted crystal-model pairs; n_benchmark_models: their distinct models; reference_cut_vc_ori_w050: the reference method's background cut, reproduced by VXH3 (to 5e-5); reference_perchain_fit_alpha_A / _beta_A: the reference method's median per-chain five-landmark fit RMSD, reproduced by VX1 (to 0.01 A). Upstream gates (pipeline/code/paths.py expected()): reference_lam_vc_ori_w050 / reference_lam_ori_vc_ori_w050: lam and lam_o of the N = 10 reference arm vc_ori_w050, reference_observed_purity_vc_ori_w050 / reference_excess_mouse_V_vc_ori_w050 / reference_z_mouse_V_vc_ori_w050: its observed purity and its excess and z within mouse + V pair (as rounded in V2_arm_comparison_vc_ori_w050.csv), reference_n_survivors_vc_ori_w050: its clusters at q <= 0.15, all reproduced by the arc30 gate G4 (a30_g4_check, with reference_cut_vc_ori_w050); reference_orientation_weight_N10: the orientation weight vec6 chose (V6_chosen_weight.json), reproduced by gate G2 (a30_2 N = 10) and read by a30_5; reference_robust_members_N10: one member clone_id per robust N = 10 cluster of an earlier record, whose recovery a30_5 reports (A5_n10_robust8_recovery.csv; context only: unset, the table has no rows); a30_1 / a30_2 also check n_control_pairs, n_background_pairs and n_benchmark_pairs.

documented_failures._comment: checks step -> list of check-name prefixes you have recorded as expected outcomes in your design; only these can be passed with --accept-documented

reference_method._comment: The established method compared against: the shipped arc30 method (pipeline/code/a30_*.py), written by run_upstream.py stage V30. Leave the block out to skip the comparison, the overlap sets and the reference row.
reference_method.name: arc30

_keep_grids_comment: false: scripts/run_pipeline.py deletes each full-repertoire grid after its last reader (peak scratch ~60 GB instead of ~180 GB)
